articles.headline: Helios is AMD’s first AI system to rival Nvidia Vera Rubin — we got an exclusive, first look
articles.summary: AMD is one of the best performing chip stocks of 2026, after a decade-long comeback in data center chips. Now, its biggest competitive move against Nvidia is here: Helios - the world’s first rival to Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin rack-scale systems for AI. Microsoft, Meta, OpenAI and Oracle are all early adopters. But with a price tag at least $1 million more than Vera Rubin, CNBC asks leaders what sets it apart from Nvidia. Here’s an exclusive first look inside the 7,000 pound behemoth.
